asof_rule: Use only facts whose measurement end and SEC filed date are on or before the selection as-of date; a frozen panel may use the selection only on or after that date.
survivorship_note: The public SEC-float membership rule is forward-only from the first archived symbol snapshot. The separate private liquidity diagnostic can look back no earlier than the Massive market_eod archive, which begins in 2024-07. Neither rule may be represented as a historical universe before its source archive begins.
license_note: US-government public-domain source data (17 USC 105); derived work, freely redistributable.
rank_observation_rule: For each listed, non-ETF, non-test-issue SEC CIK, select the latest positive finite dei:EntityPublicFloat observation whose measurement end and filed date are both on or before asof; rank descending and break equal values by SEC-dash ticker ascending.
comment: Licensing decision made during M5 implementation on 2026-07-30: Massive Market Data Terms section 5(c) prohibits distributing Derived Works, so no Massive-derived membership, value, rank, or rank order enters this public repository. The legacy liq1000_v1 identifier is retained for the pre-registered milestone contract. The 63-day/minimum-observation/minimum-close fields define the private Vault liquidity diagnostic and are not public-membership filters under the SEC-float fallback. Target 1000 is retained because the repository's null simulation estimates E[max IC] at 0.122 for N=500 versus 0.306 for N=82, while a 1000-name large-public-float cross-section remains appropriate for paper-scale research.
